summary: The two critical methodological issues identified in attempt 1 (test-set leakage in target threshold computation and information leakage from amount-correlated features) have been successfully corrected. The plan now enforces strict train-test separation, uses only claim-intake-time features, and all execution completed successfully with required artifacts produced. Model performance is consistent with class imbalance (5% positive rate) and appropriately documented in caveats. Output is ready for sponsor review.
